entities.summary: James Stephen Hogg was an American lawyer and statesman who served as the 20th governor of Texas from 1891 to 1895. He was born near Rusk, Texas. Hogg was a follower of the conservative New South Creed which became popular following the U.S. Civil War, and was also associated with populism. He was the first Texas Governor to have been born in the state. James Stephen Hogg was a legal figures from Rusk (1851-03-24, Rusk–1906-03-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
